classification: deliberately reviewed Codex host wrappers; not a bulk synchronization or maintained project source

adapters.name: using-superpowers
adapters.description: Use when skill discovery or workflow selection is unclear, or the user explicitly requests this skill.
adapters.generic_behavior: normal relevance and explicit user selection

adapters.name: brainstorming
adapters.description: Use when material product or technical design choices remain unsettled before implementation.
adapters.generic_behavior: resolve only material open design choices

adapters.name: awwv-read-first
adapters.description: Use when an AWWV reading guide is requested or subsystem ownership cannot be established from the repository entrypoint.
adapters.generic_behavior: project-specific; defers to another repository's own entrypoint outside AWWV

adapters.name: writing-plans
adapters.description: Use when a multi-step implementation needs a written plan or the user asks for an implementation plan.
adapters.generic_behavior: outcome/scope/authority/check based planning without forced execution

adapters.name: executing-plans
adapters.description: Use when carrying out an authorized implementation plan through its required checks and closeout.
adapters.generic_behavior: complete authorized dependency-ordered work without fixed feedback stops

adapters.name: prompt-construction
adapters.description: Use when drafting a task prompt, agent handoff, or instructions for another coding environment.

adapters.name: awwv-make-cursor-prompt
adapters.description: Use when the user requests an AWWV prompt for Cursor or another coding agent.

adapters.name: verification-before-completion
adapters.description: Use before claiming work is complete, fixed, passing, or ready for integration.
adapters.generic_behavior: fresh relevant evidence and explicit reuse of unaffected checks

adapters.name: napkin
adapters.description: Use when a repository napkin or runbook index needs curation because verified recurring knowledge or an explicit maintenance request warrants it.
adapters.generic_behavior: conditional runbook-index curation with no edit-on-read

shared_host_rule: In AWWV, each wrapper reads the matching repo skill, repository AGENTS.md, and relevant active Codex runtime instructions. Codex tool/model/permission policy remains host-owned; Claude hook coverage is not inferred.
deployment_owner: Parent owns original-to-candidate diffs, hash-gated deployment/rollback, distribution manifest, importer and tests.
